title: Villa Galini
meta_description: Villa Galini is a breezy coastal retreat near the beach with a golf cart, outdoor shower, smart TVs, and spacious rooms---perfect for relaxed group getaways.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Villa Galini, a bright and welcoming retreat perfectly positioned near the beach---crafted for comfort, ease, and unforgettable coastal memories.

Nestled in a quiet neighborhood just moments from the shoreline, this spacious four-bedroom home is ideal for families or groups looking to relax, recharge, and explore the Gulf Coast. Hop on the on-site golf cart and head to the beach, or rinse off in the outdoor shower after a day in the sand---beach gear is included to make your adventures seamless.

Inside, you'll find a cozy and thoughtfully styled living area with comfortable seating and a smart TV, perfect for unwinding after the day's adventures. The open-concept layout flows into a dining space and fully equipped kitchen, making it easy to gather for meals or casual conversations.

Each bedroom is designed with relaxation in mind and features its own smart TV. The primary suite offers a king bed, daybed and trundle, and a private ensuite bathroom---an inviting space to settle in and stretch out. Bedroom 2 also boasts a king bed and ensuite, bedroom 3 has a cozy queen, and bedroom 4 is perfect for younger guests or extra flexibility with two twin-over-twin bunk beds.

A washer and dryer are available in-home for added convenience, making longer stays a breeze.

Whether you're cruising to the beach, enjoying a laid-back evening indoors, or rinsing off under the stars in the outdoor shower, Villa Galini offers the perfect blend of comfort and coastal charm for your next beach escape.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows pets for a fee. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Guests must be 25 years or older to book this home.

Parking Details:
- Parking is available for 2 cars.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
